title: Formation of the Kerr black hole: an exact model
summary: We present an exact analytical model of axisymmetric gravitational collapse leading to the formation of the Kerr black hole. The model depends only on the total mass ${\cal M}$ and a time dependent rotation parameter $a(v)$, and incorporates both the extremal Kerr black hole and a novel quasi extremal regime without requiring $a\approx{\cal M}$. The evolution develops curvature singularities induced by $a(v)$, which are expected to remain enclosed within a trapped region close to the evolving Kerr radius $r=h(v)$.
